server.externalUrl.desc: Base URL of MRH ManSys server, used for generating external links.

server.name.desc: A recognizable name for the server. Shown when connected with MRH ManSys Desktop.

server.hosts.desc: Multiple hosts the server will accept requests from.

auth.allowSignup.desc: Whether to allow new user registrations.

auth.allowSignupForOauth.desc: Whether to allow new registrations via configured OAuth providers.

auth.mode.desc: Active authentication method. Only one method can be active at a time.

auth.enterprise.autoRegister.desc: Whether users authenticated by enterprise backends can be auto-created.

auth.enterprise.allowedEmailDomains.desc: Allowed enterprise email domains in JSON array format.

auth.enterprise.ldap.bindDN.desc: LDAP service bind DN used to search users.

auth.enterprise.ldap.searchFilter.desc: LDAP search filter with placeholders {{email}} and {{username}}.

auth.enterprise.ldap.nameAttribute.desc: LDAP attribute used as display name when auto-registering users.

auth.enterprise.ldap.connectTimeoutMs.desc: LDAP TCP connect timeout in milliseconds.

auth.enterprise.ldap.rejectUnauthorized.desc: Whether to reject invalid TLS certificates for LDAPS.

mailer.SMTP.name.desc: Hostname used for SMTP HELO/EHLO. Leave empty to use system hostname.

mailer.SMTP.port.desc: Port of the email server (commonly 25, 465 or 587).

mailer.SMTP.username.desc: Username used to authenticate the email server.

mailer.SMTP.password.desc: Password used to authenticate the email server.

mailer.fallbackSMTP.password.desc: Password for the fallback SMTP server.

mailer.SMTP.ignoreTLS.desc: Whether to ignore TLS certificate verification. Enable for self-signed certificates.

mailer.SMTP.sender.desc: Sender address for all outgoing emails.

storages.blob.storage.provider.desc: The storage provider for user uploaded blobs (images, videos, etc.).

storages.blob.storage.bucket.desc: The bucket name for blob storage (used with S3/R2 providers).

storages.blob.storage.config.desc: S3-compatible config for the storage provider (endpoint/region/credentials).

storages.avatar.storage.provider.desc: The storage provider for user avatars.

storages.avatar.storage.bucket.desc: The bucket name for avatar storage (used with S3/R2 providers).

storages.avatar.storage.config.desc: S3-compatible config for the avatar storage provider.

storages.avatar.publicPath.desc: The public path prefix for user avatars.

oauth.providers.google.desc: Google OAuth provider config (clientId, clientSecret, etc.).

oauth.providers.github.desc: GitHub OAuth provider config (clientId, clientSecret, etc.).

oauth.providers.oidc.desc: OIDC OAuth provider config (issuer, clientId, clientSecret, etc.).

copilot.enabled.desc: Whether to enable the AI copilot plugin.

copilot.unsplash.desc: Unsplash API key config for image search.

copilot.exa.desc: Exa web search API key config.

copilot.storage.provider.desc: The storage provider for copilot blobs.

copilot.storage.bucket.desc: The bucket name for copilot blobs storage.

copilot.storage.config.desc: S3-compatible config for the copilot storage provider.
